name: com.accesscalibrate
description: A ~60-second motor-ability calibration that proposes accessibility settings (timing, hold-to-toggle, mashing, deadzone, remapping) using transparent, developer-configured rules. The player always has the final say. Not a medical tool; thresholds are hypothetical and not clinically validated.

samples.description: A short 3D platformer level (1–2 minutes) that shows the effect of every setting. Requires URP with a Universal (3D) renderer. Models: Quaternius, CC0.
